title: Lenny Bruce and The Mothers Concert Poster
coreRelationships: The central portrait of Lenny Bruce is the focal point, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
Large, flowing serif typography for 'LENNY BRUCE' dominates the upper half, acting as a primary identifier.
The dark brown text and portrait contrast sharply with the vibrant orange background.
Event details are arranged around the central portrait, guiding the eye through the information.
The '24-25' date is rendered in a large, decorative font, anchoring the lower right section.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage concert poster by using a vibrant orange background and dark brown for all text and a stylized, high-contrast portrait. Employ a flowing, decorative serif font for prominent names and event details, arranging information densely around the central portrait to maintain a 1960s psychedelic aesthetic.
